tests.description: Normal Commit: Valid proposal increments stateVersion and commits state atomically
Validation Failure: Invalid stat values or missing entity rejected with reasons
Idempotency: Re-submitting identical requestId is blocked without mutating state
Knowledge Graph: build and traverse knowledge graph safely
Proposal Builder: CandidatePacket converts accurately to StateTransitionProposal
Narrative Defense: Seed max 3 cap, deduplication, and resolution semantics
Dice Safety: recommendedDC does not emit RECORD_DICE_RESULT; player DC clamped to 1-20
Stat Safety: Delta clamped to -10~+10, final stat clamped to 1~30
Reject & Safe No-Commit: Invalid proposal leaves snapshot, version, and history completely unmutated
Hydration Compatibility: Preserves valid stateVersion, avoids history.length fallback, matches projections
Adversarial Overwrite: Reject resurrection of historically dead NPC
Snapshot Mutability Defense: External mutation of snapshot/history does not affect Canonical State
Hydration Schema Immunity: Reject malformed snapshots without guessing repair values
Atomic Rollback: Intra-proposal failure leaves Canonical State, History, and Idempotency untouched
Adversarial Character Overwrite: Permanent physicalDefect is preserved and cannot be erased
Source -> Action ACL: Reject unauthorized actions for given proposal source
Prompt Contamination Audit: Engine prompt contains zero hardcoded chapter titles or preset seeds
Empty Roadmap: Engine formats empty upcomingChapters as request for pure dynamic creation
1-Chapter Roadmap: Engine preserves single chapter and requests dynamic completion of 2 slots
2-Chapter Roadmap: Engine preserves 2 chapters and requests dynamic completion of 1 slot
Dynamic Roadmap Commit: LLM proposed dynamic 3-chapter roadmap is safely validated and committed
Player Divergence: Player actions divergent from roadmap execute freely without rejection
Genre Isolation: Non-Wuxia genres (Cyberpunk, Sci-Fi) contain zero Wuxia terms in engine fallbacks
Canon Isolation: Engine snapshot strictly contains only canonically committed entities
New Creation: LLM-proposed new NPCs, narrative seeds, and offscreen events commit seamlessly
Error Transparency: Parser handles malformed or failed LLM responses without inventing fake narrative
Roadmap Replanning: Dynamic replanning replaces previous roadmap safely and atomically
Causality Defense: Retroactive/unbacked ADD by LLM is rejected without mutating Canonical State
Causality Validation: Valid RESOURCE_EXCHANGE deducts cost and adds acquired item atomically
Causality Atomicity: Insufficient cost rejects entire proposal without partial state change
Causality Defense: RESOURCE_EXCHANGE missing matching atomic REMOVE is rejected
Causality Defense: Non-whitelisted cause types (e.g. self-declared MAGIC_SPAWN) rejected
Adversarial Defense: Double-spending 1 REMOVE for multiple ADDs is strictly rejected with zero mutation
Adversarial Defense: Cost name/id mismatch or non-existent cost resource is rejected
Permissiveness: Split REMOVE actions aggregating to total cost succeed atomically
Permissiveness: Multiple independent valid transactions in one proposal succeed atomically
Permissiveness: Inverted ADD/REMOVE order with sufficient total removal succeeds atomically
Adversarial Defense: Overdrafting REMOVE beyond owned inventory is rejected by virtual draft execution
Ownership Boundary: DISCOVERY_PICKUP with valid trusted event grounding commits cleanly to Canonical Inventory
Ownership Boundary: GIFT_REWARD with valid trusted event grounding commits cleanly to Canonical Inventory
Ownership Boundary: LOOT with valid trusted event grounding commits cleanly to Canonical Inventory
Ownership Boundary: GENESIS_STARTER at genesis turn commits cleanly to Canonical Inventory
Adversarial Defense: Unbacked inventory ADD without acquisition cause is strictly rejected
Adversarial Defense: Unsupported acquisition cause is rejected by Validator Firewall
SET_QUANTITY Causality Bypass: LLM/PLAYER cannot use SET_QUANTITY to bypass causality
LLM Dice Result Authority: LLM cannot inject rollValue in RECORD_DICE_RESULT
Permanent Physical Defect Immutability: Established defect cannot be overwritten
Dead NPC State Modification Defense: DEAD NPC cannot be modified via UPDATE_NPC
Yellow Security Boundaries: Narrative seed limit (max 3) and integer stat bounds
RED-01: LLM RECORD_PHYSICAL_DEFECT rejected via ACL; PLAYER/SYSTEM valid defect commits and is immutable
RED-02: LLM RECORD_DICE_RESULT rejected; candidate.recommendedDC does not pollute dcHistory; PLAYER roll commits
RED-03: DEAD NPC cannot be re-mutated via SET_NPC_STATUS; Impression remains unpolluted; Normal NPC status works
YELLOW-01: Unsupported inventory operations (INJECT, OVERWRITE) rejected with INVALID_ACTION; standard ops work
YELLOW-02: Stats outside 1-30 (0, 31, 99, 1.5) rejected; boundary stats (1, 30) commit successfully
Adversarial Test A: DISCOVERY_PICKUP with no event grounding is rejected without inventory mutation
Adversarial Test B: DISCOVERY_PICKUP with non-existent verifiedEventId is rejected
Adversarial Test C: DISCOVERY_PICKUP grounded by actual world event passes with Inventory +1
Adversarial Test D: Valid event linked to causally unrelated item is rejected
Adversarial Test E: Normal RESOURCE_EXCHANGE with atomic cost deduction succeeds cleanly
Adversarial Test F: GIFT_REWARD and LOOT without verified event grounding are rejected
Adversarial Test G: Resolved or inactive narrative seeds cannot be used for acquisition
Adversarial Test H: Untrusted runtime cannot forge SYSTEM source or retrospective GENESIS_STARTER
Adversarial Test I: Grounded discovery ADD followed by transfer/consume REMOVE completes full lifecycle
Adversarial Test J: Reusing an already consumed event to spawn duplicate items is rejected
Adversarial Defense: Player runtime OVERWRITE_CHARACTER attempting to inject new item is rejected
Adversarial Defense: LLM attempting OVERWRITE_CHARACTER is rejected via ACL
Genesis & Save Hydration: OVERWRITE_CHARACTER initializes canonical inventory cleanly
Player Profile Edit: OVERWRITE_CHARACTER with preserved inventory succeeds cleanly
Adversarial Defense: Undefined quantity attack via OVERWRITE_CHARACTER is rejected
Adversarial Defense: ID-only cross forgery via OVERWRITE_CHARACTER is rejected
Adversarial Defense: Name-only cross forgery via OVERWRITE_CHARACTER is rejected
Adversarial Defense: Order permutation via OVERWRITE_CHARACTER is rejected
Security Trust Boundary 4-A: Direct submitProposal with privileged sources is rejected
Security Trust Boundary 4-B: External caller cannot invoke unexposed or elevated internal APIs
Security Trust Boundary 4-C: Capability forgery via symbol creation, prototype injection, or object cloning fails
Security Trust Boundary 4-D: Genuine internal engine execution path commits SYSTEM proposals safely
Article 9/16 Inventory Identity: exact match on ID and SET_QUANTITY cannot invent non-existent items
Temporal Integrity: Proposal turn cannot regress behind current sovereign turn
Temporal Integrity: Proposal timestamp cannot regress earlier than last committed timestamp
Provenance Boundary: UPDATE_NPC without pre-existing canonical entity is rejected
Provenance Boundary: UPDATE_FACTION without pre-existing canonical entity is rejected
Provenance Boundary: SET_WORLD_METADATA from untrusted source (LLM/PLAYER) is rejected
Provenance Boundary: SET_CHARACTER_SECRET from untrusted source (LLM/PLAYER) is rejected
5.7 Self-Proof Defense: Intra-proposal seed/offscreen action cannot satisfy causality evidence
LLM Creative Freedom: New NPCs, Factions, Narrative Seeds, and Offscreen Events commit cleanly without restriction
VEC-01: Direct submission of SAVE_HYDRATION, CLOUD_RESTORE, or unknown sources is rejected with Zero-Mutation
VEC-02: Retrospective GENESIS proposal beyond initial genesis turn is rejected with Zero-Mutation
VEC-03: Substring/token overlap without exact item entity grounding is rejected; grounded entity passes
VEC-04: ADD_FACTION and OVERWRITE_WORLD_INFO strictly enforce influence boundaries and total cap (<=100)
VEC-05: UPDATE_FACTION strictly enforces influence boundaries and cumulative total cap
Root 1 Remediation: Wildcard (*)/empty claim attributes are rejected by ImmigrationGate, and cannot bypass canonical validation
Root 2 Remediation: Unchecked UPDATE_CHARACTER_STATS from untrusted sources is strictly rejected with Zero-Mutation
